phases.name: Pipeline Domain Logic (WS + M1)
phases.description: Implement pure-function domain logic: pipeline stage ordering from transitions.ts, stalled idea detection (>30 days), and actor role resolution. These are leaf dependencies with no UI, testable via unit tests alone.

steps.name: Implement pipeline-stages pure functions
steps.criteria: getStageIndex returns correct 0-based index for all 7 forward stages; isStageReached returns true for stages at or before current status; isCurrentStage returns true only when stage equals current status; PIPELINE_STAGES constant excludes REJECTED and matches ALL_STATUSES order from transitions.ts
steps.scenario_name: Pipeline component reuses stage logic from transitions.ts
steps.description: Replace RED scaffold with working implementations of getStageIndex, isStageReached, isCurrentStage. PIPELINE_STAGES already filters REJECTED correctly in scaffold; verify and implement the three functions.
acceptance_criteria: getStageIndex('SUBMITTED') === 0, getStageIndex('COMPLETED') === 6
isStageReached('SUBMITTED', 'ELIGIBLE') === true
isStageReached('IN_VOTING', 'ELIGIBLE') === false
isCurrentStage('ELIGIBLE', 'ELIGIBLE') === true
isCurrentStage('SUBMITTED', 'ELIGIBLE') === false
deliverables: Unit tests covering all 7 stages and boundary cases
steps.implementation_notes: Functional composition -- pure functions, no classes. Derive from ALL_STATUSES in transitions.ts, filter out REJECTED. Do not duplicate stage ordering; import from transitions.ts. TRACEABILITY: Unit-level ACs here correspond to user-observable behavior in step 02-03 (IdeaPipeline renders 7 stages in correct order) and integration-checkpoints.feature scenario 'Pipeline component reuses stage logic from transitions.ts'.

steps.name: Implement stalled-detector pure function
steps.criteria: detectStalledIdea returns isStalled=true when daysSinceLastChange >= 30 for non-COMPLETED, non-SUBMITTED statuses; returns isStalled=false for COMPLETED regardless of days; returns isStalled=false when days < 30; waitingForLabel is derived from STALLED_WAITING_LABELS map with correct stage-to-label mappings
steps.scenario_name: Stalled idea shows "Waiting for" label with days count
steps.description: Replace RED scaffold with working detectStalledIdea. Fix STALLED_WAITING_LABELS per upstream-issues.md: ELIGIBLE should map to 'Eligibility assessment' (not 'Voting period'), IN_VOTING to 'Public voting period', SELECTED to 'Selection for implementation'. Add SUBMITTED and COMPLETED with empty labels (never stalled).
acceptance_criteria: detectStalledIdea('UNDER_REVIEW', date35DaysAgo).isStalled === true
detectStalledIdea('UNDER_REVIEW', date35DaysAgo).daysSinceLastChange === 35
detectStalledIdea('UNDER_REVIEW', date35DaysAgo).waitingForLabel === 'City department review'
detectStalledIdea('UNDER_REVIEW', date15DaysAgo).isStalled === false
detectStalledIdea('COMPLETED', date60DaysAgo).isStalled === false
detectStalledIdea('ELIGIBLE', date40DaysAgo).waitingForLabel === 'Eligibility assessment'
deliverables: Working stalled-detector.ts with corrected label mappings
steps.implementation_notes: Fix STALLED_WAITING_LABELS per upstream-issues.md item 3. Full mapping: SUBMITTED->'Submission received', UNDER_REVIEW->'City department review', ELIGIBLE->'Eligibility assessment', IN_VOTING->'Public voting period', SELECTED->'Selection for implementation', IN_PROGRESS->'Implementation in progress'. SUBMITTED and COMPLETED never show stalled indicator. TRACEABILITY: Unit-level ACs here correspond to user-observable behavior in step 02-02 (StalledIndicator renders 'Waiting for: {label}' and '{N} days ago').

steps.name: Implement actor-role-resolver pure function
steps.criteria: resolveActorRole returns 'Admin' for changedBy matching known admin patterns (admin@, moderator@); returns 'System' for changedBy equal to 'system'; returns 'Department' for any unknown changedBy value; gracefully handles empty or malformed input
steps.scenario_name: Actor role derived from changedBy field
steps.description: Replace RED scaffold with working resolveActorRole. KNOWN_ADMIN_PATTERNS already defined in scaffold. Add 'system' exact match for System role. Unknown patterns fall through to 'Department'.
acceptance_criteria: resolveActorRole('admin@cluj.ro') === 'Admin'
resolveActorRole('moderator@city.cluj.ro') === 'Admin'
resolveActorRole('system') === 'System'
resolveActorRole('unknown-user@example.com') === 'Department'
resolveActorRole('') === 'Department'
deliverables: Unit tests covering all three roles and fallback
steps.implementation_notes: Functional composition -- pure function. Check KNOWN_ADMIN_PATTERNS first (substring match), then exact 'system' match, then default to 'Department'. This is used by StatusChangeTimeline but is a leaf dependency with no UI coupling. TRACEABILITY: Unit-level ACs here correspond to user-observable behavior in step 04-01 (StatusChangeTimeline shows actor role as 'Admin'/'System'/'Department').

Add Notification namespace locale keys: optInPrompt, optInDescription, ideaMovedTo, viewIdea. Browser notification: new Notification(title, { body, tag: `idea-${id}-status`, data: { url } }). onClick: window.focus() + navigate to idea. Per D5: browser-only, no email.
